segments.name: Infrastructure
segments.description: Leases and rents fiber optic networks and telecommunication towers in Mexico through First Towers.
segments.evidence: Infrastructure activities is a new segment of the Company pursuant to the acquisition of First Towers in August 2025 which relates to the leasing and/or rental of fiber optic networks and telecommunication towers at First Towers in Mexico.

segments.name: Cultivation
segments.description: Cultivated medical cannabis in Portugal through RPK/Holigen until the business was sold in March 2024.
segments.evidence: Cultivating activities which comprise the "cultivation" segment is made up of the medical cannabis cultivation operations at RPK/Holigen in Portugal up until the sale completion in March 2024 (refer to note 5).

segments.name: Distribution
segments.description: Distributed medical cannabis products in the United Kingdom through Canmart until its winding up in May 2025.
segments.evidence: Distributing activities relate to the distribution of medical cannabis by Canmart in the United Kingdom up until the winding up in May 2025 (refer to note 6).

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from leasing telecommunications infrastructure, including tower sites and dark fiber routes, all located in Mexico.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company, through its subsidiary – First Towers, generates revenue from the leasing of telecommunications infrastructure, including tower sites and dark fiber routes.

changes.text: In 2024, the company sold RPK, its Portuguese medical cannabis cultivation business, exiting the European cultivation operations.
changes.evidence: On March 24, 2024, the Company completed the transaction with Somai for the sale of RPK.

changes.text: In 2025, the company added a new Infrastructure segment through the acquisition of First Towers in Mexico.
changes.evidence: Infrastructure activities is a new segment of the Company pursuant to the acquisition of First Towers in August 2025 which relates to the leasing and/or rental of fiber optic networks and telecommunication towers at First Towers in Mexico.
